steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's eligibility criteria to ensure your background meets their standards. You'll work through real scenarios, exam-style questions, and project-management frameworks—all on a schedule that fits working professionals in the Warner Robins area.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your training hours, submit your formal application to PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process and documentation. PMI will review your credentials and approve your eligibility to sit for the exam.

steps_items.text: With Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation support, you'll sharpen your test-taking strategy and review high-value content areas. We offer practice exams and targeted coaching to build confidence. You'll then schedule and complete the PMP® exam at an approved testing center.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP® credential is valid for three years. During your renewal cycle, earn professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, or other approved learning activities. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education resources to help you stay current and maintain your certification.
